question: What would an experienced business analyst expect in this kind of business that is missing from the functional requirements?

needs.need: The business needs to dynamically adjust delivery fees and commissions based on real-time demand, weather, and traffic conditions to maintain profitability and service levels.
needs.why: Static pricing models fail in hyperlocal Q-Commerce where supply and demand fluctuate rapidly, directly impacting revenue optimization and SLA adherence.
